facts.claim_text: Maintain fall precautions given bed rest and weak gait/transferring.
facts.text: The patient is on bed rest.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Nursing assessments on 2182-01-08 document 'Ambulatory aid: Bed rest (0)' and 'Gait/Transferring: Bed rest (0)' (08:30 and 12:58), and the later 20:00 'Ambulatory aid: None (0)' is the same Morse fall-scale category (none/bed rest), so the records support the patient being on bed rest at the decision time.

facts.claim_text: Maintain fall precautions given bed rest and weak gait/transferring.
facts.text: The patient has weak gait and impaired transferring.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The most recent gait/transferring assessment before the decision time (R47, 2182-01-08 20:00) records 'Gait/Transferring: Weak (10)', consistent with weak gait and impaired transferring; an earlier assessment (R2) shows the same finding.

facts.claim_text: Assess and manage inadequate nutrition per Braden nutrition score.

facts.reason: The Braden Nutrition score is documented as 'Probably Inadequate (2)' repeatedly, most recently at 20:00 on 2182-01-08 (R42), and the diet is NPO (R7), explicitly supporting that inadequate nutrition is present.
